cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 567fb435 adds source-only provider fanout and focused tests, still unrun. Commit b5f1a236 adds an emergency freeze/pause; 108e6f96 adds canonical operation IDs; 5964c17c adds signed amount/ledger bounds and tests. These additions remain uncompiled/unrun. Commit 62550164 added fail-closed route/status/frontend guards, also uncompiled/unrun. The pure 2-of-3 matching helpers remain without independent provider configuration or live calls. Direct provider endpoint probes could not run under local DNS sandbox; candidates remain unvalidated. Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these changes. No actual Horizon outcall or live deposit credit exists; pending claims/receipts remain dormant state, not a live lifecycle. No XLM registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: A source scaffold adds a Frozen NativeXlm config constructor and generic update_collateral_config rejects the canonical XLM key and NativeXlm. Persistent pending-deposit and receipt state plus pure quorum/matching helpers exist in source, but are not wired into live processing or Cargo-verified. Commits b5f1a236 and 108e6f96 add an emergency freeze/pause and canonical operation IDs; 5964c17c adds signed amount/ledger bounds and tests, unrun. Claim/intent/receipt state remains dormant and creates no live credit. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Source-only guards now fail closed on unsupported generic and native-XLM fallback paths. Commits b5f1a236 and 108e6f96 add emergency freeze/pause and canonical operation IDs; 5964c17c adds signed amount/ledger bounds and tests, all still uncompiled/unrun. A pure credit helper is under active source work but is not a live deposit flow. WP3 remains blocked: there is no XLM deposit/borrow endpoint or live credit/receipt/tombstone lifecycle. Key/network/provider binding, reserve freshness/oracle verification, and testnet/frontend integration remain open. No XLM admission is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commits 6da8cd46, 3e12fba5, and 62550164 added source-level fail-closed payout and route/status/frontend guards. Commits b5f1a236 and 108e6f96 add emergency freeze/pause and canonical operation IDs; 5964c17c adds signed bounds/tests, all uncompiled/unrun. Claim settlement and payout remain unsupported, so WP4 stays blocked. A live XRP post-sign status race is a separate claim-reuse caution, not an XLM-specific required gate. Key/network/provider binding, current reserve/oracle checks, and testnet/release work remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission.

cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. The latest source adds fail-closed frontend/status handling, but it remains uncompiled/unrun; complete XLM frontend integration and lifecycle flows remain open. No supported XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, or claim user flow is available.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34, before recent commits. Commits 567fb435, b5f1a236, 108e6f96, and 5964c17c add provider fanout/tests, emergency freeze/pause, canonical operation IDs, and signed amount/ledger bounds/tests; none has been compiled or run. The pure credit source helper and Stability Pool retry guard are being developed by source agents; neither is verified. Major open work: XLM key/network/provider binding; deposit credit, receipt, and tombstone wiring; current reserve freshness/oracle; claim settlement; testnet, frontend, and release. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second design review are complete; this is not full research completion. The live XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not a required XLM gate. WP3/WP4 remain blocked; no admission or deployment is proved.
